_: THE LAST ASCENT — nest_4. Re-run with: tools/shot.sh --seq=tools/seq/nest_4.json
One capture per screen, one per recalled lesson — the sluice (World 2), the
__: flue (World 3), the unlit fault and comb (World 4), the levers (World 5) —
___: the two pairs the level is actually about (A1 shut/open with the teeth
____: appearing overhead in the same frame, B1 shut/open from the same tile), and
_____: last the quiet stretch and the boss's door.

_: GOTCHAS, every one of them paid for at least once in this project:
__: * a bare {"settle": n} is a NO-OP — `settle` is only read by `scenario`
___: and `teleport`. The waiting step is {"wait": n}.
____: * teleport puts the TOP-LEFT of a 22 px body on the tile's top-left, so
_____: her feet land 6 px into the row below. Onto solid rock that pushes her
______: back up and she stands on the row you named; onto a ONE-WAY tread she
_______: falls through it, so aim a row high and let her drop.
________: * teleporting onto the exit tile completes the level and the capture
_________: lands on the hub. Stand beside it.
__________: * settle 210 rather than 90: the level-title card is still up at 90.
___________: * a teleport does not change FORM. Land on the pad's own tile, wait for
____________: TransformPad to fire, and teleport on from there.
_____________: * a teleport onto a lever's tile DOES throw it: SwitchTrigger tests the
______________: overlap every frame and its box is the bottom 10 px of the tile. That is
_______________: how the before/after pairs below are taken, and it is also why the order
________________: of this file matters — A is thrown at step F and stays thrown.
_________________: * a teleport onto a tile whose floor is SOLID lands her INSIDE the cap and
__________________: the collision pushes her out sideways: the first run of this file caught
___________________: shot F with Kaya in mid-air over the well. Aim one row high everywhere and
_____________________: * ENEMIES ARE ALIVE AND KAYA IS NOT INVULNERABLE HERE (that is the tape
______________________: replay's flag, not this harness's). The first run of this file died during
_______________________: the 210-frame title settle -- the walker on the apron chases from 96 px --
________________________: and the level RESTARTED mid-file, which silently reset both switch groups:
_________________________: every shot after it was the wrong configuration. So this file is three
__________________________: short passes, each starting from a fresh level with five hearts, each
___________________________: re-throwing what it needs. A long single pass cannot be trusted.

_: AMBIENCE: this level wants the data/ambience.json entry printed by
__: `"$PYVENV" tools/worlds/nest_4.py`, which is what makes cols 23-38 the
___: unlit stretch the World 4 leg is built out of. Without it the level loads
____: with the DEFAULT ambience — jungle backdrop, no ember, no pools — so every
_____: capture here is the same geometry with the lights on everywhere. The dark
______: is authored as an absence of pools, so it cannot be captured until the
_______: entry lands; what these shots do prove is the geometry the absence sits on,
________: including the obsidian_hot banding and the shard bed that are the only
_________: things meant to glow in there.

_: A — THE FOOT, screen (0,1). The apron, the walker, the nest_crust vault two
__: tiles west of the spawn, and the sluice's surface starting at col 9.

_: B — THE SUMP. Three rows of air over two of water: she wades off the apron
__: at the same floor level, which is why there is no step to find here.

_: C — THE SEAM, IN STILL WATER. The vertical screen seam is x=400, the line
__: between cols 24 and 25, and cols 24-26 carry no push for exactly that
___: reason: a body inching across it at 1 px/s flips the camera back and forth.
____: This is the pipe — two tiles tall with rock on row 25, so there is no
_____: surface to swim along and the current is the whole cross-section.

_: D — WORLD 2 RECALLED: inside the push. water_current_right is 68 px/s and
__: Kaya makes 108 * 0.62 = 66.96, so swimming back west she makes +1.04 px/s
___: EAST. Held left for a second here and she is still drifting the other way.
____: That is THE CISTERN's measurement, restated in black glass.

_: E — THE WELL'S STAIR, screen (1,1). Two steps of nest_block sixteen pixels
__: apart with the water still over the lower one: (36,27) the step, (37,26) the
___: beach flush with the surface, (38,25) the ledge. The first draft jumped this
____: in one go; it proved, at 43,882 expansions out of 50,000.

_: F — WORLD 5, UP CLOSE. A1 SHUT: the gold plug at col 43 rows 23-24 is the
__: flue's gate, three tiles east of its own lever, and the ceiling over the
___: ledge's east end is bare. Taken from the ledge so the lever, the gate and
____: the empty ceiling are one frame.

_: G — THE SAME FRAME, ONE THROW LATER. Teleporting onto (40,24) trips the
__: lever. The gate sinks and the other half of the same group RISES two tiles
___: over her head at cols 41-42: one lever, two things, both on screen. The
____: callback is the comb at shot L, sixteen rows up and a screen across.
_____: MEASURED, and it cost this file two runs: SwitchTrigger re-arms after 27
______: frames, so a body that STAYS on a lever throws it twice and the capture
_______: shows the state you started in. Land on it, give it 12, step off, shoot --
________: and shoot from the same tile the before-shot was taken from, so the pair
_________: is one difference and not two.

_: H — WORLD 3 RECALLED: the flue. pad_bird is on the LEDGE and not in the
__: column, because the column has no floor a body can rest on — updraft is
___: [0,-400] against a bird's fall cap of 190, so anything inside it is already
____: going up at 210 px/s. Stand on the pad first: a teleport does not transform.

_: I — MID-RIDE, across the horizontal seam. Teleported into the column at row
__: 22 and given ten frames -- she is at row 21 doing -77 px/s when the shutter
___: opens. The whole climb is seventeen rows in about 1.3 s, so this is the only
____: way to photograph it. nest_flue is drawn up the back of the shaft, which is
_____: what makes the one lane in the level that moves you look like it.

_: PASS 2 — a fresh level, and the first thing it does is throw A: everything
__: above the flue is a room the player can only be in with group A OFF, which
___: is the whole of the comb's argument, and a capture in the wrong
____: configuration is a photograph of a level nobody can play.

_: J — THE LANDING, screen (1,0), capped level with the top of the column with
__: pad_human one tile west of the mouth. Walking east off this ledge is not a
___: death: Kaya's own fall cap in there is 330-400 = -70 px/s, so the flue
____: catches her and hands her back. Taken from the mouth end with 25 frames of
_____: settle: the landing's walker chases at 54 px/s and needs 53 of them to
______: cross three tiles, so this is the frame before the fight rather than during

_: K — WORLD 4 RECALLED: THE FAULT. Two rows down, a bed of nest_shard in the
__: bottom, two tiles of it and never three — a three-tile hole is four tiles of
___: travel and the conservative flood every check in the module runs on cannot
____: cross it. The obsidian_hot bands on the take-offs and the shards themselves
_____: are the only things in these sixteen columns that the ambience entry lights.

_: L — THE COMB, which is lever A's callback. The teeth hanging at rows 4-5 are
__: solid because A was thrown at shot G, a screen away and sixteen rows down;
___: the pillars at rows 4-7 are the same group the other way round and are open.
____: With A un-thrown this corridor is a wall. The player walks under the teeth

_: M — THE HALL, screen (0,0), with B1 SHUT. The door into the last stair is
__: the gold plug at col 13 rows 6-7; the slot above it at rows 3-4 is THE
___: WINDOW and is never plugged. Lever B is on the nest_block bracket at cols
____: 20-22, two rows over the lane — out of the line a blade thrown from inside
_____: the doorway flies along, and seven tiles from the window so it cannot be

_: PASS 3 — a fresh level again, so the hearts are full for the last four
__: frames. Nothing down here depends on group A, and B is thrown by falling
___: onto its bracket from one row up: the bracket is a ONE-WAY tread, so a
____: teleport onto its own tile drops straight through it.

_: N — ONE THROW LATER, same screen. B1 opens and so does B2, eleven tiles
__: away at the top of the stair, in a room this lever cannot see. The last
___: lever in the game opens the last two doors in the game.

_: O — THE WINDOW FROM INSIDE, and the reason this level has no softlock. From
__: the stair's first tread the slot is one row up and two tiles across; from
___: the gallery floor its feet row is three rows up against a measured rise of
____: two, with nothing on that side to stand on. So the stair always drains back
_____: to lever B and the only way UP is still the door.

_: P — THE QUIET. Three treads, a heart, gems, no lever, no hazard, no enemy,
__: and B2 already open across the top tread: the only screen in World 5 that
___: asks for nothing. Standing one tile east of the exit, because teleporting
____: onto it finishes the level and the capture lands on the hub.

_: Q — THE BOSS'S DOOR, from the tile beside it. The end of the ordinary game.
